features.name: Spells
features.description: Casts arcane spells from the wizard spell list, prepared from a spellbook. Intelligence determines bonus spells and spell save DCs.

features.name: Cantrips
features.description: Can prepare a number of 0-level spells each day, and can cast them repeatedly.

features.name: Arcane Bond
features.description: Forms a bond with either an object (an amulet, ring, staff, wand, or weapon) or a familiar.

features.name: Arcane School
features.description: Choose a school of magic to specialize in, or become a generalist.

features.name: Scribe Scroll
features.description: Gains Scribe Scroll as a bonus feat.

features.name: Eschew Materials
features.description: Gains Eschew Materials as a bonus feat.

features.name: Bonus Feat
features.description: Gain a metamagic feat, item creation feat, or Spell Mastery. Another at every fifth level after 5th.
